rules: Music in priority order; measure the real per-second cost with a 10 s sketch first; at most one retry per sound; every take goes in elevenlabs/ledger.json; confirm costs on the dashboard (the API counter lags). Music is composed in code (cmd/audiogen/music.go); these music prompts are kept for a paid plan.

sounds.prompt: Epic instrumental main theme for a frontier colony-building game. Opens alone with a fingerpicked acoustic guitar motif at dusk (0:00-0:35); warm low strings and a soft French horn take up the motif (0:35-1:20); builds to a full orchestral swell with deep frame drums, soaring violins and horns carrying the melody (1:20-2:25); eases back down through strings (2:25-3:00) and ends on the lone guitar motif, softly, so it can loop (3:00-3:30). Hopeful, adventurous, a little lonely. No vocals, no lyrics, no choir.
sounds.done: not generated: ElevenLabs has no music API on the free tier (HTTP 402); composed in code instead (make music)
